description: This file is a shell test script that verifies the behavior of diff heuristics related to indentation, using git commands to setup test scenarios and compare outputs. It includes test cases for diff and blame commands with different heuristic settings and file types.

methods.name: compare_diff
methods.description: Compares two diff output files after removing 'index' lines, asserting they are identical.

methods.name: compare_blame
methods.description: Compares blame output files after processing to ignore boundary lines, asserting they are identical.
